purpose: Lock scalable spatial/data rules before Unity implementation without using the heavy runner.

world.coordinateSystem: continuous logical XZ world coordinates; rendering may be sector-local but IDs/positions remain stable

partition.sector: streamable gameplay subdivision inside a region
partition.chunk: runtime culling/loading unit; exact size intentionally deferred to profiling
partition.rule: Region 1 slice uses one visible sector but data must not assume the whole world fits in one scene.

ids.entities: stable string IDs independent of GameObject names and visual prefab names

constraints: not hardcoded to Region 1 prototype coordinates

rules: resource type separate from visual prefab
visual variation does not alter gameplay identity

poi.rule: narrative/neutral/hostile semantics separated from presentation asset

streaming.now: single bounded Region 1 sector may be fully resident
future: no save data stored only in scene objects

navigation.march: logical origin/target/path/travel time stored independently from rendered march marker
navigation.routes: authored/readable roads are presentation/navigation cues, not mandatory graph edges unless future pathfinding requires it

antiLockIn: Do not key gameplay from Unity hierarchy names.
Do not store world state inside art prefabs.
Do not hardcode Region 1 POIs into camera controller.
Do not make Valoria scene own world state.
Do not assume one player city exists globally.
Do not assume one region or one loaded sector exists forever.
